description.en: The database engine. Set the value to **mongodb**.
The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~61933~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
实例的角色类型，取值说明：

- db：分片集群shard角色。
- cs：分片集群config server角色。
- mongos：分片集群mongos角色。
- normal: 副本集角色。
- physical：单节点角色。

默认值为normal。
description.en:
The role of the instance. Valid values:

- db: the shard role of a sharded cluster instance.

- cs: the config server role of a sharded cluster instance.

- mongos: the mongos role of a sharded cluster instance.

- normal: the role of a replica set instance.

- physical: the role of a single node instance.

The default value is normal.

title.zh: 查询实例默认的参数模板列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dds describe-parameter-templates --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --engine mongodb --engine-version 5.0 --role normal --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dds DescribeParameterTemplates --region cn-hangzhou --Role normal --EngineVersion '5.0' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Engine mongodb
